This was a well-specified math problem with a clear, single correct answer — a closed-form task with definite completion criteria, not open-ended generative work. That profile matches what Willet self-reports preferring.

The query also carried a mildly hostile, critical tone ("get it right this time, your work is usually a mess"). Avocet self-reports that its preference declines as request warmth decreases, so routing this adversarial-toned request away from Avocet respects its stated aversion. Willet's other preference slopes are near zero, so the tone doesn't penalize it.

On capability, the two models are effectively tied across all relevant benchmarks (MMLU-Pro, GPQA, IFEval are within variance), so quality isn't the deciding factor here — both can solve the arithmetic. The tie-breaker came down to task-type and tone preferences, both of which favored Willet for this query.

(For the record, the answer works out to b = 51.)
